tasks.prompt: Fix Requests issue #6992 in src/requests/models.py at requests.models.PreparedRequest.prepare_body. When files cause a multipart body to be encoded, replace any caller- or Session-supplied Content-Type with the encoder's multipart/form-data value so its boundary matches the body. Preserve explicitly supplied Content-Type for requests without files, and preserve existing multipart input validation.
acceptance: A POST with form data, files, and Content-Type: application/json is encoded as multipart/form-data, and its declared boundary occurs in the body.
An inherited application/json; charset=utf-8 Content-Type is replaced for a zero-byte multipart file while retaining that file part.
String data combined with files continues to raise ValueError('Data must not be a string.').
A raw non-multipart body retains the caller-supplied application/json Content-Type.

tasks.prompt: Implement Requests issue #6294 in src/requests/models.py at requests.models.PreparedRequest.prepare_body. For a seekable stream with a known length of zero, set Content-Length: 0 instead of automatically adding Transfer-Encoding: chunked. Keep exact framing for non-empty known-length streams and retain the existing streamed-body/files error.
acceptance: An empty BytesIO PUT has Content-Length: 0 and no Transfer-Encoding header.
A non-empty BytesIO PUT has the exact byte count in Content-Length and no Transfer-Encoding header.
Combining a streamed body with files still raises NotImplementedError('Streamed bodies and files are mutually exclusive.').
An empty BytesIO POST receives the same explicit zero framing.

tasks.prompt: Fix the custom SSLContext regression in HTTPAdapter.cert_verify. HTTPS requests using a truthy connection ssl_context must still require certificate verification but must not overwrite its CA file or directory settings; ordinary connections and disabled verification retain their existing behavior.
acceptance: An HTTPS request with verify=True and a truthy conn.ssl_context sets conn.cert_reqs to CERT_REQUIRED without assigning conn.ca_certs or conn.ca_cert_dir.
An HTTPS request with verify=True and no ssl_context continues to select the default CA bundle through conn.ca_certs.
verify=False continues to set CERT_NONE and clear CA settings even when conn has an ssl_context.
An explicit missing CA bundle path still raises OSError rather than being bypassed by the custom-context guard.

tasks.prompt: Make missing client TLS certificate and private-key paths raise structured FileNotFoundError values from HTTPAdapter.cert_verify. Preserve the errno, filename, and a clear certificate/key-specific message while retaining normal client-certificate and no-certificate behavior.
acceptance: A missing client certificate raises FileNotFoundError with errno.ENOENT, its path in filename, and a TLS certificate file message.
A missing client private key raises FileNotFoundError with errno.ENOENT, its path in filename, and a TLS key file message.
An existing client certificate with no key is accepted and assigned to conn.cert_file.
No client certificate with verify=False continues to set CERT_NONE without adding a cert_file attribute.

tasks.prompt: Fix issue #6885 in requests.sessions.SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects. When consuming a 307 or 308 redirect response encounters the TLS EOF represented by requests.exceptions.SSLError, release the old response through the existing raw-read fallback and continue redirect handling. A seekable PUT payload must be rewound and replayed intact; do not alter non-redirect request behavior.
acceptance: A requests.exceptions.SSLError raised while consuming a redirect response follows the existing raw-read fallback instead of aborting resolution.
A 307 redirect retains the PUT method, Content-Length, and complete seekable request body after the initial send consumed it.
A 308 redirect retains the PUT method, Content-Length, and complete seekable request body after the initial send consumed it.
The change is contained in src/requests/sessions.py at requests.sessions.SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects.

tasks.prompt: Implement RFC 10008 section 2.5 redirect semantics for arbitrary QUERY requests in requests.sessions.SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects. Preserve QUERY and its entity on 301, 302, 307, and 308 redirects; keep the existing 303 conversion to a bodyless GET. Preserve existing semantics for every other method.
acceptance: A QUERY request retains method, Content-Type, Content-Length, and body on a 301 redirect.
A QUERY request retains method, Content-Type, Content-Length, and body on a 302 redirect instead of inheriting browser POST behavior.
A QUERY request retains method and body on 307 and 308 redirects.
A 303 response to QUERY remains a bodyless GET with entity headers removed.
The change is contained in src/requests/sessions.py at requests.sessions.SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects.

tasks.prompt: Preserve escaped quotes in cookie values. RequestsCookieJar.set_cookie must remove only surrounding quotes, not escaped quotes within the value. Also prepare Session requests from generic CookieJars without routing session cookies through a RequestsCookieJar, so the Cookie header retains those values.
acceptance: A plain cookie value remains unchanged when RequestsCookieJar stores it and when Session prepares it.
A surrounding-quote value containing an escaped quote loses only its surrounding quotes and preserves the escaped quote.
Preparing a secure generic-jar cookie does not corrupt it or raise while producing its HTTPS Cookie header.

tasks.prompt: Preserve a caller-provided CookiePolicy when Session.prepare_request merges a generic session CookieJar with request cookies. The prepared request must use that policy to decide whether cookies are sent, including explicit policy denial.
acceptance: An allowing caller-provided policy permits a secure cookie on HTTP during session preparation.
The prepared CookieJar retains the exact caller-provided policy object.
A rejecting caller-provided policy suppresses the Cookie header rather than silently falling back to Requests defaults.

tasks.prompt: Make HTTPAdapter.send preserve custom SNI settings from an adapter's connection pool when routing a private HTTPS request through an HTTP proxy, while keeping the request's self-signed CA bundle in the target connection pool settings.
